create.name: Integral Yoga Centre of Melbourne
create.bio:
The Integral Yoga Centre of Melbourne is a volunteer-run incorporated association, formed in June 2018, that carries on the Integral Yoga of Swami Satchidananda in Victoria, where the method has been taught for close to fifty years. Chitra and Hridayan Stern are among its longest-serving teachers, and a small committee of teachers keeps the programme going.

Weekly classes take place in the ground-floor community room of the Murrumbeena Park Community Hub in Melbourne's south-east, with two of the evening sessions also streamed on Zoom. There is a gentle Monday-morning class for newcomers and people returning after a break, and multilevel classes on Monday and Tuesday evenings that offer fuller variations to experienced students. A class follows the classic Integral Yoga shape of postures, guided deep relaxation, breathing practice and a closing meditation.

Beyond the classes, the centre hosts Saturday-evening satsangs in members' homes, built around chanting, a talk by a senior teacher or visiting guest, a short meditation and a shared vegetarian supper. It also runs the 200-hour Integral Yoga Hatha I teacher training in Australia, spread over twelve months in two modules that mix residential retreats, training days and home practice.

courses.title: Class passes (Murrumbeena and online)
courses.description: Passes valid across every weekly class and teacher: gentle Monday-morning yoga, and multilevel Monday and Tuesday evening classes at Murrumbeena Park Community Hub, two of them also on Zoom. A 14-day unlimited intro pass is offered to newcomers.
courses.price: Intro Pass $35 (14 days, new students); casual $25; 10 class pass $220 or $190 concession

courses.title: Satsang evenings
courses.description: Saturday-evening gatherings, usually in a member's home, with chanting, a talk on yoga practice or philosophy by a senior teacher or guest, a short meditation and a shared vegetarian supper. Open to students, newcomers, friends and family; write to the centre for the next date.

courses.title: Integral Yoga 200-hour Hatha I Teacher Training
courses.description: A 12-month, two-module certification: Living Integral Yoga (the six branches and personal practice), then a second module on how to lead a basic Level 1 hatha class. Combines residential retreats, non-residential training days, home practice and assessed tasks; Module 1 can be taken alone. Expressions of interest are open for the next intake.
